title: White Crane - Teaching Views
description: Reviewed single-person movement clips at their original speed. Continuous movement boundaries are editorial; no timing rescale or interpolation.
provenance: Reviewed local teaching-source footage. Original files and previous playlists are preserved.

clips.title: White Crane - Side View
clips.description: Gather the rear foot, transfer weight, and separate the arms into the crane posture.
clips.trackingNotes: Both arm separations and both leg chains have complete observed coverage in this view.
clips.focusSelectionProvenance: Manual semantic limb selection audited against actual cached 12 Hz MediaPipe Lite observations and unchanged practice-relaxed-v1.1 rules. See artifacts/teaching-review/FOCUS.md.
clips.selectionReason: Begin before the instructor lowers from the initial held posture; retain the gathering step, weight transfer, arm separation, and completed crane posture. Exclude the long initial hold and the transition graphic at 24 seconds.
clips.boundaryEvidence: Manually reviewed timestamped source frames and neighboring movement transitions. Routine form names use the existing reviewed 24-form taxonomy.
clips.boundaryPrecision: Editorial transition in continuous movement; approximately 0.5-second review precision. Encoding cuts use the exact recorded frame indices.
clips.orientation: Source labels this scene Side View; the performer turns within the scene. No horizontal flip.
clips.provenance: Locally downloaded instructor footage; reference landmarks must be real MediaPipe inference of this encoded clip. No fabricated landmarks or physical-camera validation.
